import json
from collections import Counter
def transform(grid, fill):
    c=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marker=[k for k in c if k!=bg][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,row in enumerate(out):
        idxs=[j for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==marker]
        if len(idxs)>=2:
            for j in range(idxs[0],idxs[-1]+1):
                if row[j]==bg: out[i][j]=fill
    return out
G=load()
r=transform(G['Test input'],7)
print(json.dumps(r))
